adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` the new fallback logic in `updateEvent` is self-contradictory:

```ts
const selectedCalendar = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

The `.find(...)` branch only executes when `externalCalendarId` is falsy/undefined, but then compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., against the same falsy value), so it cannot select a meaningful calendar from `event.destinationCalendar`. This makes the intended fallback ineffective and can break updates when callers don’t already provide an `externalCalendarId` (similar issue is also introduced in `deleteEvent`).
